ruleReferences.questionParaphrase: With initially equal hand counts, does Ampharos using Flashing Bolt receive Synchro Pulse +80 when the defending Active holds Lucky Helmet?
ruleReferences.answerParaphrase: Yes. Lucky Helmet draws after attack damage, so that later hand-count change does not remove the bonus.

sections: II D-13 suppression example printed page36
ruleReferences.facts: Determine base damage, then attacker bonuses, then Weakness/Resistance. Multiple applicable attacker bonuses add. Zero-base damage ends calculation before ordinary boosts. Counter placement is a non-damage effect. Automatic Abilities operate without declaration. Damage reactions follow damage. Removed Abilities do not function; the example restores them when suppression ends.

reviewedSemantics: This strengthens attacks used by THIS Ampharos only. It is not a field aura for all of the controller's Active Pokemon.

Evaluate current hand counts when attack damage is calculated, after before-damage effects and before damage-received reactions. An already calculated damage amount is not revised when Lucky Helmet subsequently draws cards.

No separate Active-only source condition is printed. SELF scopes the modifier to the Ability holder as actual attacking Pokemon; normally that Pokemon is Active. Do not introduce source_active_only or root IS_ACTIVE. A Benched Ampharos does not boost another attacker.

Multiple Ampharos do not give a common attacker +160/+240: each modifier affects its own holder. Independent applicable modifiers on the attacking holder add normally. There is no shared once-per-turn flag or nonstacking group in the text.

The bonus is absent while this holder's Ability is suppressed and returns when suppression ends if current hands match. This is the existing suppression-aware passive path, not a permanent status installed when Ampharos evolves.

No increase to damage-counter placement, self damage, opponent Bench damage, or other Pokemon's attacks. An attack with zero determined base damage does not become damaging solely from this ordinary +80 modifier.
No cost, manual activation, target selection, use quota or player opt-out. Do not expose private hand identities; only existing public counts are needed.
